rules.statement: Каждый игрок получает секретный персонаж и принадлежит к одной из сторон: good или evil.
rules.reason: The deal permutation test asserts the assignment is a permutation of the bag; character secrecy is asserted by the projection test.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/setup.test.ts::a deal rejects an assignment that is not a permutation of the bag.
test: src/ui/screens/player-projection.test.ts::the player handoff projection carries only public seat data and the shown role.
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Setup.r1361.wikitext § Pass Out Character Tokens.

rules.statement: Днём игроки разговаривают между собой и голосуют за казнь.
rules.reason: Daytime conversation is player conduct with no engine behavior. The vote half is mechanical and asserted by the shared vote rules.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a living player may nominate only once per day and a player may be nominated only once per day (SYS-VOTES-01); src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::execution requires at least half the living players (SYS-VOTES-02). No test can assert free discussion.

rules.statement: Ночью игроки закрывают глаза, а персонажи с ночными способностями просыпаются, чтобы действовать или получить информацию.
rules.reason: Closing eyes is physical player conduct. The mechanical night wake and order half is asserted by the shared night rules.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::Bad Moon Rising rosters, composition and night order follow the official data (SYS-NIGHT-01); src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a player killed before their night wake is skipped (SYS-NIGHT-03).

rules.statement: Игроки могут говорить что угодно и когда угодно: публично или наедине.
rules.reason: Free speech in public or private is player conduct; the app records no conversation.
rules.evidence: No engine path models speech; src/core/model/state.ts::publicGameView exposes only phase, day, night, living, total, deaths and winner.

rules.statement: Игрокам запрещено показывать свой жетон персонажа другим и смотреть в Grimoire.
rules.reason: Showing a token or reading the Grimoire is physical player conduct, not an engine state.
rules.evidence: No engine path accepts a token reveal or grimoire read; the private state is kept out of src/core/model/state.ts::publicGameView.

rules.statement: Игрок может задать Ведущему любой вопрос; Ведущий нейтрален и обязан помочь понять правила.
rules.reason: Answering rules questions and remaining neutral is Storyteller conduct; the app is an aid, not a rules oracle.
rules.evidence: No engine path records a rules question or a neutrality decision.

rules.statement: Игроки должны уважительно относиться друг к другу.
rules.reason: Respectful conduct is a social contract with no engine behavior.
rules.evidence: No engine path models player conduct.

rules.statement: Мёртвые игроки продолжают участвовать в обсуждении, закрывают глаза ночью и выигрывают или проигрывают вместе со своей командой.
rules.reason: Dead players talking and closing their eyes is player conduct. Team outcomes are asserted separately by role rules; no general engine sentence exists to assert.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::execution is an execution event, not automatically a death (SYS-WINS-01); src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::an Evil Twin killed by the Vigormortis still wins on the good twin's execution (SNV-EVILTWIN-01).

rules.statement: Смерть не заканчивает участие игрока: он может говорить и голосовать в пределах оставленного права голоса.
rules.reason: A dead player talking is player conduct. The remaining vote token is mechanical and asserted by SYS-VOTES-03.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::dead votes count once, are spent on a failed nomination, and cannot repeat (SYS-VOTES-03).

rules.statement: Если способность использует слово "choose" ("выберите"), решение принимает игрок; если это слово отсутствует, решение принимает Ведущий.
rules.reason: The choose/no-choose wording assigns a decision to the player or the Storyteller; the app records host and player choices, so the wording rule itself is adjudication.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/host-choice.test.ts covers host-choice steps; no engine path derives choice ownership from the ability wording.

rules.statement: Если способность говорит "might" ("может"), Ведущий решает, произойдёт ли событие.
rules.reason: The might wording leaves the event to Storyteller judgment; there is no deterministic engine behavior to assert.
rules.evidence: No engine path resolves a might ability automatically; host adjudication records the outcome.

rules.statement: Днём игроки открывают глаза, общаются и голосуют за казнь; каждая ночь следует за днём и предшествует следующему дню.
rules.reason: Daytime conversation is player conduct. The night/day alternation is mechanical and asserted by SYS-LIFECYCLE-01.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/lifecycle.test.ts::a full play cycle follows the declared transitions (SYS-LIFECYCLE-01).

rules.statement: В любой момент игрок либо жив, либо мёртв.
rules.reason: alive and deadAt remain one exclusive pair through a kill, a resurrection and both manual life corrections.
rules.evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::the alive and deadAt fields stay one exclusive pair through kill, resurrection and correction (DEATH-001).

rules.statement: Мёртвый игрок не может умереть снова; атака по мёртвому не убивает его, и группа не узнаёт о таком событии.
rules.reason: An attack on an already dead player is a no-op, and no death or dawn record is created. Existing role tests assert both the no-kill and the no-record behavior.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::an Imp attack on an already dead player kills no one (TB-IMP-01); src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a Fang Gu attack on an already dead Outsider does not jump (SNV-FANGGU-03); src/ui/screens/table/helpers.test.ts::dawnReport names the night deaths and counts the survivors — a player with no death record cannot be announced.

rules.statement: Смерть наступает в основном от казни днём и от способностей персонажей ночью.
rules.reason: Deaths record their cause and phase, and both execution and ability deaths are asserted across the engine.
rules.evidence: src/core/model/types.ts::Death carries cause, phase and number; src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::Undertaker learns an execution death, not a night death (TB-UNDERTAKER-01); src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a sober Tinker dies from an ability death during the day and the night (BMR-TINKER-01).

rules.statement: Казнь — это групповое решение убить игрока, не являющегося Traveller, в течение дня.
rules.reason: The group decision is exercised by SYS-VOTES-04, execution is day-only under SYS-LIFECYCLE-02, and Travellers cannot be seated, so the non-Traveller clause has no legal input.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::the unique most-voted nominee is executed, and a tie blocks every execution (SYS-VOTES-04).
test: src/core/engine/lifecycle.test.ts::the lifecycle guard rejects each command outside its declared phases (SYS-LIFECYCLE-02).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Rules_Explanation.r1310.wikitext § Execution.

rules.statement: В день допускается не более одной казни, но казни может не быть вовсе.
rules.reason: The day holds at most one execution and may end with none. Tests assert a second execution is refused and an execution-free day is legal.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::official execution of a dead player records an event without another death — after the first execution a second executeByDecision is refused; src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::the Mastermind extra day ends good when nobody is executed (BMR-MASTERMIND-01).

rules.statement: Если казнённый игрок остаётся жив благодаря способности, это всё равно считается казнью дня; другая казнь в этот день невозможна.
rules.reason: Ability-prevented survival is recorded as the day's execution and closes the day; a second execution is rejected with error.23.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::a Tea Lady's protected neighbour survives an execution (BMR-TEALADY-01) — day.execution is set with a null deathId, the day ends, executions.length is 1 and a second executeByDecision returns error.23.
test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::official execution of a dead player records an event without another death.

rules.statement: Изгнание (exile) — это групповое решение убить Traveller в течение дня; изгнаний в день может быть сколько угодно, включая ноль.
rules.reason: Out of scope for this release: supported scripts exclude Travellers, setup rejects the traveller team, and rosters are capped at 5–15. Exile only concerns seated Travellers, so no exile decision exists to implement.
rules.evidence: No exile command or state exists in src/core; src/core/engine/setup-commands.ts rejects the traveller team and Traveller ids are collected but never seated.

rules.statement: Любой игрок может поддержать изгнание, включая мёртвых игроков без vote-жетона; изгнание не является голосованием и казнью.
rules.reason: Out of scope for this release: supported scripts exclude Travellers, setup rejects the traveller team, and rosters are capped at 5–15. There is no seated Traveller to support, so the 'not a vote or execution' distinction has no path to assert.
rules.evidence: No exile command exists; src/core/engine/day.ts only records nominations, votes and executions.

rules.statement: Способности персонажей никак не могут влиять на решение об изгнании.
rules.reason: Out of scope for this release: supported scripts exclude Travellers, setup rejects the traveller team, and rosters are capped at 5–15. With no exile path, there is no decision for character abilities to affect.
rules.evidence: No exile path exists in src/core/engine.

rules.statement: Игрок может быть казнён несколько раз, и даже мёртвый игрок может быть казнён повторно; это не убивает мёртвого игрока.
rules.reason: The same dead player is executed on two consecutive days: both executions are recorded and the death list does not grow.
rules.evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a dead player may be executed again on a later day without a second death (EXEC-007) — two execution records for seat 2, unchanged deaths, still dead.

rules.statement: Ведущий обязан всегда давать правдивую информацию о правилах, даже drunk или poisoned игрокам.
rules.reason: Truthful rules answers are Storyteller conduct and do not depend on impairment; the engine has no rules-answer path.
rules.evidence: No engine path answers rules questions; impairment only changes ability information in src/core/engine/effects.ts.

rules.statement: Мёртвый, drunk или poisoned персонаж не имеет способности; если способность давала информацию, она не даёт её.
rules.reason: Impaired information and dead-actor skipping are both asserted by shared rules; the sentence combines two covered behaviors.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::every Trouble Brewing first-night information role offers allowed false information while impaired (SYS-EFFECTS-01, TB-EMPATH-03); src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a player killed before their night wake is skipped (SYS-NIGHT-03).

rules.statement: Demon info: на первую ночь при семи и более игроках Demon узнаёт, кто является Minion, и получает три good-персонажа, которых нет в игре, для блефа.
rules.reason: The first-night demoninfo step carries the Demon, the three bluffs and the night's Minion set; the test names the exact Minion ids, the Demon and the bluffs at 7+ and the absence of both evil-introduction steps at 5–6.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::the first-night evil introduction names the exact Minions, Demon and bluffs (INFO-004, INFO-005).
test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::5–6 player first night has no evil introduction and no bluffs (SYS-SETUP-04).

rules.statement: Minion info: на первую ночь при семи и более игроках Minions узнают других Minions и игрока-Demon.
rules.reason: The minioninfo step names the exact Minion actors and the Demon on the first night at 7+; the same test asserts no Minion or Demon introduction at 5–6.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::the first-night evil introduction names the exact Minions, Demon and bluffs (INFO-004, INFO-005) — actorIds ["6"], demonId "7", recorded given.
test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::5–6 player first night has no evil introduction and no bluffs (SYS-SETUP-04).

rules.statement: "Start knowing" означает получение знания на первую ночь; если персонаж создан посреди игры — в момент создания.
rules.reason: Start-knowing information for a character created mid-game is asserted by tests that name INFO-006; only the atomic map is missing.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a character created mid-game gains its start-knowing information that night (INFO-006, ROLE-PITHAG-003, SNV-PITHAG-01); src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a player the Pit-Hag makes the Town Crier wakes in its slot and one made the Clockmaker wakes at once (INFO-006, SNV-PITHAG-01).

rules.statement: Воскрешённый игрок получает способность обратно, даже если это "once per game", которая уже была использована; способность "first night only" срабатывает в ночь воскрешения.
rules.reason: Resurrection restores a spent once-per-game ability and wakes a first-night ability on the resurrection night; both are asserted.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::a resurrected player regains a used once-per-game ability (BMR10); src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::a regurgitated start-knowing player wakes to use the ability again (BMR10); src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::a resurrected Assassin regains the once-per-game ability (BMR-ASSASSIN-02).

rules.statement: Ночью игроки закрывают глаза; Ведущий будит только тех, кому положено действовать или получать информацию.
rules.reason: Closing eyes and waking only the actors are physical Storyteller procedure. The mechanical order and skip behavior are asserted.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::Bad Moon Rising rosters, composition and night order follow the official data (SYS-NIGHT-01); src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a player killed before their night wake is skipped (SYS-NIGHT-03).

rules.statement: Ведущий будит игрока двумя касаниями плеча или колена; на рассвете говорит "eyes open, everybody".
rules.reason: Shoulder/knee touches and the dawn phrase are physical table procedure.
rules.evidence: No engine path models a wake gesture; the night queue only names the step.

rules.statement: Ночью Ведущий общается жестами: два касания — глаза открыть, жест "закрыть глаза", "да", "нет", "good", "evil", числа и указание на игрока.
rules.reason: Storyteller gestures are physical table communication and have no engine representation.
rules.evidence: No engine path models gestures; step answers are entered as data.

rules.statement: На рассвете Ведущий объявляет, кто умер ночью, но не объявляет, как они умерли.
rules.reason: The exact instruction is in the Imp's How to Run: declare which player died at night and do not say how. The public view names deaths without their causes.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Imp.r3116.wikitext § How to Run — "At dawn, declare which player died at night. (Do not say how they died.)"
test: src/core/engine/acceptance.test.ts::a played finale replays to the same state and exposes no secrets — public deaths name players, not poison, demon, ability or execution.

rules.statement: Игроки могут обсуждать своих персонажей только после первой ночи.
rules.reason: When players may discuss their characters is player conduct.
rules.evidence: No engine path restricts or records character discussion.

rules.statement: "Each night*" означает каждую ночь, кроме первой.
rules.reason: Each-night-except-first scheduling is implemented by night-step arms and asserted by the arm tests.
rules.evidence: src/core/roles/night-step.test.ts::an arm for other nights declares nothing on the first night; src/core/roles/night-step.test.ts::a legacy first-night step replaces the night step on the first night only.

rules.statement: Для Trouble Brewing требуется не менее пяти игроков; для других изданий рекомендуется не менее семи.
rules.reason: The mandatory five-player floor is enforced and tested; the seven-player minimum for other editions is a recommendation, not engine behavior.
rules.evidence: src/core/model/scripts.test.ts::rejects scripts that are too small or miss a required team — a four-player script is rejected with an error mentioning five.

rules.statement: Перед игрой выбирается ровно одно издание: Trouble Brewing, Bad Moon Rising или Sects & Violets.
rules.reason: The setup tests reject mixed TB/BMR editions and a mixed manual pool without manual-only mode; custom and manual-only scripts are deliberate extensions outside the official one-edition constraint.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/setup.test.ts::script limits reject mixed editions, unknown roles and short rosters.
test: src/core/engine/manual.test.ts::a mixed pool without manual-only mode is rejected before dealing (SYS-SCRIPTS-05).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Setup.r1361.wikitext § Choose A Script.

rules.statement: Ведущий тайно выбирает персонажей в количестве, соответствующем числу игроков согласно setup sheet.
rules.reason: The Storyteller's secret choice of characters is host conduct. The composition count it must follow is asserted by SYS-SETUP-01.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/setup.test.ts::the official composition table covers 5 to 15 players exactly (SYS-SETUP-01).

rules.statement: Выбранные жетоны персонажей кладутся в Grimoire в порядке рассадки игроков.

source.section: Add The Character Tokens To The Grimore

rules.reason: The Grimoire read model (orderedPlayers) equals state.order after a legal deal and again after a rejected reorder.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/lifecycle.test.ts::the Grimoire order follows the seating order after a deal and a rejected reorder (SETUP-004).
test: src/core/engine/lifecycle.test.ts::a seat order change during the night is rejected and keeps the circle (SYS-LIFECYCLE-02).

rules.statement: Если на выбранном жетоне есть оранжевый лист, его квадратные скобки изменяют состав персонажей; это происходит только при подготовке и не повторяется по ходу игры.
rules.reason: Setup modifiers shift the composition only during setup: the shift is asserted by SYS-SETUP-01 and bag edits outside setup are refused.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::composition table is exact and Baron shifts two Townsfolk to Outsiders (TB-BARON-01); src/core/engine/lifecycle.test.ts::a bag edit without a roster reset is rejected during the night (SYS-LIFECYCLE-02).

rules.statement: Если на жетоне есть зелёные листья, Ведущий добавляет соответствующее число reminder-жетонов в Grimoire.

source.section: Add Reminder Tokens To The Grimore

rules.reason: Physical Grimoire preparation: the host places reminder tokens by each character's green leaves. The app stores a distinct-label checklist per role, not a green-leaf count, so a count comparison would assert the physical components rather than a game decision. Source: Setup r1361 § Add Reminder Tokens To The Grimore.
rules.evidence: test: src/core/engine/setup.test.ts::every official role has a host reminder for the secrets screen.

rules.statement: Жетоны персонажей перемешиваются в мешке; каждый игрок тайно вытягивает один и не показывает его другим.
rules.reason: The deal permutation test asserts one token per player and one character per seat.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/setup.test.ts::a deal rejects an assignment that is not a permutation of the bag.
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Setup.r1361.wikitext § Prepare The Grimoire.

rules.statement: Если игроков больше пятнадцати, лишние игроки должны добровольно стать Travellers.
rules.reason: Out of scope for this release: supported scripts exclude Travellers, setup rejects the traveller team, and rosters are capped at 5–15 seats. A game above fifteen players requires voluntarily seated Travellers and an exile path that the product deliberately does not model; it is not open engine work.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/setup-commands.ts rejects roleTeam(id) === 'traveller'; src/core/model/state.ts and setup-commands.ts clamp 5–15 seats; src/core/model/scripts.ts collects Traveller ids but never seats them.

rules.statement: Для первой игры не рекомендуется включать Travellers или Fabled.
rules.reason: The first-game recommendation about Travellers and Fabled is advice, not an engine rule.
rules.evidence: No engine path implements a first-game recommendation; see SETUP-009 for Traveller support.

rules.statement: Игроки рассаживаются по определённому кругу или квадрату с явным направлением по часовой стрелке; Ведущему оставляют проход.
rules.reason: Seating players in a circle with a Storyteller aisle is physical table setup.
rules.evidence: The app stores a seat order but models no physical arrangement; src/core/engine/lifecycle.test.ts only guards order changes.

rules.statement: Grimoire размещается так, чтобы гуляющие игроки случайно не увидели его содержимое.
rules.reason: Positioning the physical Grimoire is table setup with no engine behavior.
rules.evidence: No engine path models the Grimoire's physical position.

rules.statement: На Town Square выкладываются life-жетоны по числу игроков, жетоны голосов и Traveller sheet.
rules.reason: Life tokens, vote tokens and the Traveller sheet are physical components; the app tracks life and vote tokens as state, not table props.
rules.evidence: src/core/model/types.ts tracks alive and voteToken; no test or engine path models the Town Square components.

rules.statement: Ведущий ведёт Grimoire, соблюдает правила и принимает окончательное решение при необходимости судейства.
rules.reason: Storyteller duties and final adjudication are host conduct.
rules.evidence: No engine path models Storyteller duties; the app records host choices.

rules.statement: Ведущий может лгать игрокам в рамках игры.
rules.reason: A Storyteller's permission to lie is social conduct, not engine state.
rules.evidence: No engine path restricts or records Storyteller statements.

rules.statement: Когда способность срабатывает очевидным образом, группа узнаёт только что произошло, но не почему.
rules.reason: Storyteller presentation: the group learns what happened, not why. The engine records the cause in the secret journal and the public view names only the death, so no engine branch can enforce the spoken explanation.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Pacifist.r2601.wikitext § Summary — "when abilities like this function in obvious ways, the group is not told why something has happened, only what has happened."

rules.statement: Ведущий изображает наличие способности у drunk или poisoned игрока: будит его и проходит процедуру.
rules.reason: Pretending an impaired ability works is Storyteller procedure; the engine does build steps for impaired roles, which SYS-EFFECTS-01 asserts for information.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::every Trouble Brewing first-night information role offers allowed false information while impaired (SYS-EFFECTS-01, TB-EMPATH-03).

rules.statement: Если в тексте способности нет слова "choose", цель или результат определяет Ведущий.
rules.reason: The choose wording assigns the decision to the player or the Storyteller; this is adjudication, not deterministic engine state.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/host-choice.test.ts exercises host-choice steps; no engine path derives choice ownership from wording.

rules.statement: Если способность говорит "might", Ведущий решает, произойдёт ли событие.
rules.reason: The might wording leaves the event to Storyteller judgment.
rules.evidence: No engine path resolves a might ability automatically.

rules.statement: Игрок всегда является либо drunk, либо sober; либо poisoned, либо healthy; либо alive, либо dead; либо mad, либо sane.
rules.reason: One test derives all four pairs for every seat and asserts exactly one side of each pair holds while a player may be both drunk and poisoned.
rules.evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::every player is exactly one of each exclusive state pair (STATUS-001).

rules.statement: Опьянение и отравление дают один и тот же эффект: у игрока нет способности.
rules.reason: A clean player is not impaired, while a drunk-only and a poison-only player are both impaired through the same predicate.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::drunkenness and poisoning remove the ability in the same way (STATUS-002).
test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::every Trouble Brewing first-night information role offers allowed false information while impaired (SYS-EFFECTS-01, TB-EMPATH-03).

rules.statement: Ведущему запрещено сообщать игроку, что он drunk или poisoned; вместо этого Ведущий ведёт себя так, будто способность работает.
rules.reason: The player handoff projection test asserts only public seat data and the shown role, excluding effects and impairment; the player-facing view cannot leak the real ability.
evidence: test: src/ui/screens/player-projection.test.ts::the player handoff projection carries only public seat data and the shown role.
wiki: docs/official/wiki/States.r1039.wikitext § Drunkenness and Poisoning.

rules.statement: Опьянение и отравление не отменяют друг друга: игрок может быть одновременно drunk и poisoned.
rules.reason: Drunk and poisoned can be true together and neither cancels the other; an engine test and a gate test assert coexistence.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/commands.test.ts::a source impaired by poison and drunk loses its own effects; scripts/verification/findings.test.ts::F-010 both drunk and poisoned are true display states.

rules.statement: Способности, применённые к drunk или poisoned игроку, работают нормально.
rules.reason: An ability applied to an impaired player still works; the Tea Lady protection test asserts it directly.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::a good but drunk or poisoned Tea Lady neighbour is still protected.

rules.statement: Состояние принадлежит игроку, а не персонажу: смена персонажа или alignment не снимает drunk или poisoned.
rules.reason: A drunk and a poisoned player both keep their impairment through a character replacement.
rules.evidence: test: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a character change keeps the player's drunk and poison (STATUS-009).

rules.statement: Alignment и character независимы: смена alignment не меняет character, смена character не меняет alignment.
rules.reason: Character and alignment are separate state and role changes do not rewrite the other; the Goon and Pit-Hag tests assert each direction.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::the Assassin kills the Goon and the Goon still turns evil (BMR-ASSASSIN-01) — alignment changes while the character stays Goon; src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Pit-Hag replaces a character atomically (SNV-PITHAG-01) — the character changes without an alignment rewrite.

rules.statement: Если alignment или character игрока меняется, игрок узнаёт об этом при первой возможности тайно; это знание не является информацией и не блокируется drunk, poisoned или Vortox.
rules.reason: A character change already updates the shown role, and an alignment-only change now reaches the player handoff for the Goon: the seat projection carries the revealed alignment only for the Goon and the role card substitutes it for the printed team. The Lunatic and every other masked role stay masked. The reveal is derived from stored state, so no impairment or Vortox path can suppress it.
evidence: test: src/ui/screens/player-projection.test.ts::the Goon's own alignment reaches the player handoff (BMR-GOON-01) — good and evil; the Lunatic mask and every non-Goon seat stay null.
test: scripts/browser-check.ts::goon-alignment — a Pukka turns the Goon evil; `/player` shows the evil alignment and `/table` keeps the secret journal line.
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Goon.r2977.wikitext § How to Run — wake the Goon, give a thumbs-up or thumbs-down indicating the new alignment.

rules.statement: Регистрация ("registers as") означает, что игрок считается указанным персонажем или alignment для правил и способностей, но не получает способность этого персонажа.
rules.reason: Registering changes the reading for rules and abilities but grants no ability: a Spy registered as a Townsfolk takes no such night step and a Recluse registered as a Demon takes no Demon step, while both keep their real character and team.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::registration changes the reading and grants no character ability (STATUS-012) — the registered Spy gets no Empath step and the registered Recluse gets no Demon step.
test: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::a Spy registering as a Townsfolk triggers the Virgin and dies at once (TB-VIRGIN-01, TB-SPY-01).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Glossary.r3168.wikitext § Register line 113 — "Registering as a character does not impart that character's ability."

rules.statement: Mad означает, что игрок пытается убедить группу в чём-то; игроки никогда не обязаны быть mad.
rules.reason: Madness is what a player tries to convince the group of, and a player is never obliged to be mad; that is player conduct. Role mechanics that apply madness are tested per role.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a healthy Cerenovus makes the chosen player mad about the character until the next dawn (SNV-CERENOVUS-01).

rules.statement: Ведущий — окончательный судья в вопросе, является ли игрок mad; правил о том, что именно нужно говорить, нет.
rules.reason: The Storyteller's final judgment of madness is host adjudication.
rules.evidence: No engine path decides madness; penalties are recorded by the host in the snv madness tests.

rules.statement: Если игрок перестал быть mad, он может рассказать группе о прежнем безумии без штрафа.
rules.reason: A player revealing former madness without penalty is player conduct.
rules.evidence: No engine path records a penalty for revealing past madness.

rules.statement: Alive neighbours — два живых игрока, ближайшие по часовой и против часовой стрелки, не считая мёртвых между ними; Neighbors — два игрока независимо от жизни.
rules.reason: With dead seats around a player, allNeighbors returns the adjacent seats regardless of life while aliveNeighbors skips them.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::allNeighbors includes dead seats while aliveNeighbors skips them (STATUS-016).
test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::the Tea Lady skips dead seats to find her nearest living neighbours.
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Glossary.r3168.wikitext § Neighbors and § Alive neighbours.

rules.statement: Живой игрок может голосовать за казнь сколько угодно раз в день; мёртвый игрок может голосовать только один раз за всю оставшуюся игру.
rules.reason: The SYS-VOTES-04 test records the same living voters on two nominations in one day, so a living player may vote as many times as they want; SYS-VOTES-03 covers the single dead vote.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::the unique most-voted nominee is executed, and a tie blocks every execution (SYS-VOTES-04).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Rules_Explanation.r1310.wikitext § Voting.

rules.statement: Голоса подсчитываются по часовой стрелке и заканчиваются на номинированном игроке.
rules.reason: Counting clockwise to the nominee is a Storyteller tally procedure; recordVotes accepts the voter set, so order has no mechanical effect.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/day.ts::recordVotes takes an explicit player set; no test asserts count order.

rules.statement: Evil побеждает, когда в живых остаётся ровно два игрока, не считая Travellers.
rules.reason: The Imp kill test asserts an attack that leaves two players alive ends the game with an evil win.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::an Imp kill that leaves two players alive ends the game from the attack step (TB-IMP-01).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Glossary.r3168.wikitext § Win.

rules.statement: Живые и мёртвые игроки выигрывают и проигрывают как одна команда.
rules.reason: A dead player's team still wins or loses with the team; the Evil Twin and Mastermind tests assert both directions.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::an Evil Twin killed by the Vigormortis still wins on the good twin's execution (SNV-EVILTWIN-01); src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::an evil player executed on the Mastermind extra day loses for evil (BMR-MASTERMIND-01).
